prompt: A pencil sketch with light color wash captures a quiet snowy town square. On the left, an old stone fountain stands frozen, its basin filled with ice and snow. Next to the fountain, a woman in a blue coat wraps a thick wool scarf tightly around her neck, shivering slightly as she gazes at the icy water. In the center of the square, a tall lamppost rises, its glass lantern dark against the pale sky. Leaning against this post is a man in a grey hat, his hands buried deep in his pockets to ward off the chill. To the right of the lamppost, a small child in a yellow raincoat points excitedly toward the ground. A golden retriever sits patiently beside the child, watching the pointed finger with mild curiosity. The child drops a small red ball, and the dog lowers its head to sniff it gently. Behind them, a wooden bench holds a sleeping cat curled into a tight orange circle, oblivious to the activity. Further back on the right, a cyclist in black gear rides slowly past the bench, wheels crunching softly on the packed snow. The scene is rendered with delicate graphite lines and faint washes of blue and grey, emphasizing the cold air. There is no sun visible in the sky, leaving the landscape in a soft, diffuse twilight. The composition balances the static elements of the fountain and lamppost with the subtle movements of the figures, creating a harmonious winter tableau that feels both still and alive.
